summary_en: 50B+ yen of cross-held stocks to be sold by end-FY2/28 (vs. end-FY2/26 baseline); consolidated net asset ratio target <10% by FY2/28, <20% by FY2/27; proceeds allocated to growth investment and shareholder returns; ongoing dialogue with investee companies.
title_en: Notice regarding formulation of policy on reduction of strategic shareholdings
translation_en_brief: Toho announced on 15 July 2026 a strategic plan to reduce its portfolio of cross-held stocks. The company commits to sell cross-holdings with a book value exceeding 50 billion yen by the end of FY2028 (baseline: end-FY2026), bringing the consolidated net asset ratio below 10%. An interim milestone of <20% consolidated net asset ratio is targeted by end-FY2027, with progressive divestitures planned. The company has already divested eight holdings entirely between FY2023 and FY2026. Proceeds from the sales will be deployed first to growth investments, with remaining capital directed to shareholder returns. Toho intends to maintain constructive dialogue with investee companies throughout and after the divestment process to sustain business relationships.
